title: ADR-064 Amendment — Phase-Manifest Check Demoted to Advisory; Compound Check Retained
summary: Partially supersedes ADR-064: the Stop hook's per-phase manifest check no longer blocks under any condition, emitting a model-visible advisory instead (repeated each Stop until the artifact appears or `**In-progress phase:**` is set); the compound check (PostToolUse dispatch log + Stop-hook cross-reference) is retained but its fabrication-signal finding is also surfaced as advisory rather than block. ADR-064's State-C claim is amended from "structurally impossible" to "structurally detectable." With both checks advisory, skill-text anchoring (ADR-065) becomes the load-bearing enforcement layer; the Harness Layer's contribution shifts to visibility and detection, not prevention.
workflow_point: Stop hook phase-manifest check and compound check, across all cycle modes
mechanism: manifest check and compound-check findings demoted from blocking to model-visible advisory; skill-text anchoring (ADR-065) becomes the load-bearing enforcement layer

links.note: partially supersedes ADR-064 (IETF Updates analog): amends the Decision text's structural-prevention claim from "structurally impossible" to "structurally detectable" and demotes the phase-manifest check and compound check from blocking to advisory across all modes; ADR-064's compound-check architecture, fails-safe-to-allow rationale, and advisory-mode-vs-enforcement-mode framing remain current authority
